stories.h: Pierce County probes checkmark-signed ballot cure forms
stories.s: The auditor is investigating about two dozen cure forms with checkmarks or slashes instead of signatures. Most came from the 25th District race, which is going to a Dec. 4 hand recount. Officials say no results were affected.

stories.h: Tacoma police fatally shoot attempted-murder suspect in Fife
stories.s: Officers and SWAT shot and killed a man Wednesday on Pacific Highway East while arresting him over a weekend shooting. The state Office of Independent Investigations is leading the review.

stories.h: Robbers in hazmat suits axe cases at Proctor jeweler
stories.s: Three masked people in red hazmat suits smashed display cases at Connections Fine Jewelry on Wednesday afternoon and fled in a white BMW. No one was hurt or arrested.

coming.h: Tacoma hearing on ending parking minimums citywide
coming.s: The City Council hears a proposal to eliminate minimum off-street parking requirements, no earlier than 5:15 p.m. Tuesday. Written comments are due by 5 p.m. Monday.

coming.h: Touch tanks and tree lighting at Jerisich Dock
coming.s: Harbor WildWatch's free Touch Tanks and Tree Lighting event on the Gig Harbor waterfront, 5–7 p.m. Saturday. No RSVP is needed, and it runs rain or shine.
